description: Find what Xevol's store offers, the same listings xevol.com shows: ready-made jobs, products, services and screens from Xevol and other publishers. Pass optional words (q; every word must appear in the card), app, kind or goodFor (a kind of customer), or nothing with limit 200 for the whole store, and match it to the business yourself. Each card has `link`, the page a person opens to get it, when there is one; its address is https://xevol.com/<name>/<slug>. Free and read-only; it installs nothing.
name: search_store
title: Search Store
